set.title: 功能演示 · 安全基础
set.description: 4 道原创示例，仅用于验证软件功能，不是官方真题。

questions.question: A team wants to purchase a new security tool. What should it do FIRST?

options.B: Identify the business risk and requirements

questions.explanation: 先明确业务风险和需求，才能选择合适的控制措施。
questions.whyCorrect: 风险与业务目标决定控制措施的选择。

whyOthersWrong.C: 未经评估停用控制会增加风险。
whyOthersWrong.D: 其他组织的配置不一定适合当前业务。

questions.question: Which practice BEST supports least privilege?

options.C: Grant only access required for assigned duties

questions.explanation: 最小权限要求仅授予完成职责必需的访问权限，并定期复核。

questions.question: What is the PRIMARY purpose of testing a backup restoration procedure?

options.A: Verify that required data can be recovered
options.B: Increase the number of backup files

questions.explanation: 备份的实际价值是可恢复性，恢复演练用来验证数据和恢复流程。

questions.question: Which technique helps detect unintended changes to stored data?

options.D: Comparing cryptographic hashes with a trusted baseline

questions.explanation: 与可信基线比较密码学哈希可帮助检测完整性变化，但不能单独证明变更原因。
